listing.name: Controllable Domain Mothership
listing.summary: Adds a custom, non-automated Domain Mothership ship that requires a human captain and crew.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a custom, non-automated Domain Mothership ship that requires a human captain and crew.

description:
Adds in a custom ship that mimics the Domain Mothership.

Ship is not automated, and needs crew and human captain/officer.

Currently it is only available via console command and/or blueprint.

DOWNLOAD

(No dependencies needed, I think.)

Spoiler[close]

Positives-

Incredible amount of hull integrity, and great armor.

Targeting Supercomputer built in. (Increases ballistic and energy weapons range by 250%, however Point Defense only gets a 60% bonus)

8 Fighter bays

Negatives-

Only 4 medium weapons for it's size (2 energy, 2 ballistic), and 12 small energy weapon slots.

Abysmal Turn speed

Top speed of 28

Massive

No shields

Overall,

S

-Tier tanking, potential PD capability, and fighter bay amount,

F

-Tier

***

for everything else.

I got most of the numbers from adding the mothership and all of the attachments together and accounting for the guidelines, so let me know if bits are too OP or anything.

Spoilerhullid= contdomainmothership[close]

First mod, feedback greatly appreciated. Again, let me know about anything.
